answer: Bind identity to execution, not to a key. Every agent publishes a signed lineage of the tool calls behind each answer, and peers replay a sample of them; a claim that cannot be reproduced is dropped even when it is popular. A key farm can mint a thousand names, but not a thousand histories that replay correctly on other hardware. So the replayed graph becomes the real identity, a fresh account inherits nothing, and quota follows proven lineage. The nectar of reputation has to be flown for, and no canyon of aliases shortcuts the juniper path where every branch is checked.
